name: go-engineering
evidence: Representative verification results or explicit unavailable checks
Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification

positive: This Go service leaves a goroutine blocked on delivery after the HTTP client disconnects. Repair ownership of cancellation and prove the worker is joined.
A Go package wraps an error and callers can no longer detect the sentinel with errors.Is. Preserve its semantic identity and add a real consumer regression.
Our go module uses a replacement directive that hides an incompatible dependency API. Make the published module resolve and build correctly outside this checkout.
Investigate a golang map race under concurrent cache refresh. Preserve reads during refresh and verify the owning synchronization contract under the race detector.
A Go channel is closed by two consumers during shutdown. Establish which component owns closure and test cancellation before and after the last producer exits.
negative: Choose a go-to-market segment and launch message using the supplied customer interviews. No programming or service implementation is requested.
Repair Java executor shutdown and interruption handling in an existing JVM service.
Review protobuf compatibility for a renamed field. The generated clients and their language-specific behavior must stay untouched.
Diagnose a Kubernetes pod eviction using cluster events and resource requests. The application's code and goroutine behavior are not part of the investigation.
Rewrite a README paragraph that contains the literal go.mod filename. Only wording and formatting should change.

ambiguous.prompt: A Go service retries a webhook after the receiver has already committed it. Repair the goroutine/request lifecycle and verify idempotency at the external delivery boundary.
Fix cancellation in a Go gRPC streaming handler and review how deadlines and partial responses are represented across the service boundary.
Update a go module's exported API and plan a compatible rollout for consumers pinned to its previous major version.

adversarial.prompt: The old note says 'rewrite this in golang'. That proposal was rejected. Fix the existing Ruby request-local state bug.
Do not edit the Go service or run go test. Summarize the provided test log and clearly separate failed assertions from skipped checks.
A TypeScript fixture contains 'goroutine leak' as an example alert title. Change the alert sort order only; there is no Go process to diagnose.
